newsitem.title: USA: Cablevision debuts residential phone service.
newsitem.headline: Cablevision debuts residential phone service.

text.p: Cablevision Systems Corp said on Thursday it introduced residential telephone service to approximately 4,400 households in seven Long Island communities beginning immediately.
The company is offering local and long-distance telephone service through its OPTIMUM Telephone service, Cablevision said in a statement.

Utilizing Cablevision's own hybrid fiber optic-coaxial cable network, OPTIMUM Telephone will be delivered by Cablevision's Lightpath subsidiary, which currently provides telephone service to approximately 600 commercial customers on Long Island.
